notes: Mostly about the hobo audience and the moving-picture show, not Allen. Death is only implied; the 1907 article (221) says Allen died about two years earlier (about 1905), which conflicts with this article's implication that he was dead by August 1903. The dream passage with Tom Allen at the piano is imagery, not extracted. The cup and English-title lines are garbled in the OCR and not extracted. The McCoy-Maher film fight is not Allen's.
